limits: Static source evidence only; no game/DLL execution or live tooltip observation.
Only raw abilityType0 and1 are named. Absence, inherited defaults and other values remain unknown; no default-passive generalization to all integers.

The rendered category can instead be aura: a separately fetched abilityAura/selector2 branch overwrites the label before the active0 switch. Type naming and final tooltip category must remain separate.
The same-source native GetTalentInfo/constructor/copy/compare/dispatcher bindings are required. This does not certify an across-version enum.
Direct-call inventory is bounded to compiled E8 calls and decoded references, not dynamically rebound or indirect calls.
No defaults inferred for388 absent fields.
Fresh receiver and complete field write sets reuse exact-source owner certificates; values are independently re-read from native setter arguments or payload stores.
Inline register zeros require a dominating zero instruction with no later same-register write on a normal path to that payload store; nonvolatile GPRs use the reviewed Windowsx64 ABI.

passive.condition: native default category retained for finite abilityType1 when aura is false; an independent explicit !=Int64(1) branch occurs at0x933bbcb

owner_evidence.scope: fresh named field receiver and complete writer set; numeric values independently re-read from native instructions
